Table.name: 04_REGLEMENTAIRE
Table.comment:
Regulatory Information Objective: To certify the conformity of products with certain regulations that have a direct impact on the marketing of products and the legal responsibility of the actors. - This block of data concerns only the references covered by one of the regulations identified (marketing subject to the availability of a data, price repercussions, liability commitment, etc.). - Includes, among others, ACS: Attestation of Health Conformity; BATTERY: Air Cargo Control of Batteries and Accumulators; WOOD: EU Wood Regulations; EEC: Energy Saving Certificate; CONTRIB: Eco-contributions (WEEE, AED) and SORECOP; DOP: Declaration Of Performance (Construction Product Regulation); E-ENV-SAN: Environmental and Health Label; ECCN : Export Control; F- GAS: Refrigerant Regulation; SDS: Safety Data Sheet; NFS: Certificate of Compliance with NF S 61937; RECHANG: Duration of Availability of Spare Parts; ROHS: Compliance with RoHS requirements; TRACE: Product Traceability; TRIMAN: Sorting instruction for recycling
Informations réglementaires Objectif : Attester la conformité des produits à certaines réglementations ayant une incidence directe sur la commercialisation des produits et la responsabilité juridique des acteurs - Ce bloc de données concerne uniquement les références visées par l'une des règlementations identifiées (commercialisation conditionnée à la disponibilité d'une donnée, répercussion tarifaire, engagement de responsabilité...) - Comprend notamment, ACS : Attestation de Conformité Sanitaire ; BATTERY : Contrôle du fret aérien des piles et accumulateurs ; BOIS : Réglementation Bois de l'UE ; CEE : Certificat d'Economie d'Energie ; CONTRIB : Eco-contributions (DEEE, DEA) et SORECOP ; DOP : Declaration Of Performance (Règlement Produit de construction) ; E-ENV-SAN : Etiquette environnementale et sanitaire ; ECCN : Contrôle des exportations ; F- GAZ : Règlementation relative aux fluides frigorigènes ; FDS : Fiche de donnée de Sécurité ; NFS : Certificat de conformité à la NF S 61937 ; RECHANG : Durée de la disponibilité des pièces détachées ; ROHS : Conformité aux exigences RoHS ; TRACE : Traçabilité des produits ; TRIMAN : Consigne de tri en vue du recyclage

Column.name: MARQUE
Column.comment: Name of the marketing brand of the reference. Is equal, by default, to MANUFACTURER

Column.name: RTYP
Column.comment: 18 types of Regulations ACS : Attestation of Health Conformity BATTERY: Air Cargo Control of Batteries and Accumulators WOOD: EU Wood Regulations EEC: Energy Saving Certificate CONTRIB: Eco-contributions (WEEE, AED) and SORECOP (private copy) DOC: Declaration Of Conformity DOP: Declaration Of Performance (Construction Product Regulation) E-ENV-SAN: Environmental and Health Labels ECCN: Export Controls F-GAZ: Refrigerants regulation MSDS: Material Safety Data Sheet FTFV: End-of-Life Treatment Record NFS: Certificate of conformity to NF S 61937 PEREMP: Type of expiry date, CSD or MDD RECHANG: Duration of spare parts availability ROHS: RoHS Compliance TRACE: Product traceability TRIMAN: Sorting instruction for recycling (Triman) Each type of Regulation (RTYP) corresponds to an obligation to provide information to customers (professionals or individuals) involving a particular set of fields to be communicated when marketing the product (e.g. date, certificate, amount, code, duration, postal address, etc.). Below is a summary of the fields to be filled in by type of regulation the description of the fields is described in the tab "Regulatory table".

Column.name: RNUM
Column.comment: Order number of the information by trade reference. Whole number. Field always filled in, default value = 1

Column.name: RNAT
Column.comment: Nature of the data required by the regulations, associated with RTYP The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RCOD
Column.comment: Code required by regulation. The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RNBR
Column.comment: Quantity or number of elements associated with RCOD. An integer number. The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RTEXTE
Column.comment: Text required by regulation The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RDATE
Column.comment: Date required by regulation The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RVAL
Column.comment: Numerical value associated with RVU and required by regulation The definition and values used for this field are customized for each regulation: see description in the "Regulatory table" tab.

Column.name: RVU
Column.comment: Unit of the numerical value required by regulation

Column.name: RNOM
Column.comment: Name of document required by regulation 3 ways of making the document available : - in DOCUMENT (see description of this data block on the first page of the manual) - via the download link in the RURLT field - via the RURL link for direct display on the merchant site Number of free characters.

Column.name: RURL
Column.comment: RURL: link for displaying the regulatory document without storage by the Distributor Recommended number of characters: less than 2,000

Column.name: RURLT
Column.comment: RURLT: URL link to download the document for inclusion in the Distributor's PIM Recommended number of characters: less than 2,000
